title: On $q$-pre-Lie algebras
summary: In this paper, we introduce the notion of $q$-pre-Lie algebras from the perspective of representations of Lie algebras, providing a parametrized generalization that unifies pre-Lie algebras and anti-pre-Lie algebras. For a $q$-pre-Lie algebra $(A,\circ)$, the commutator of $\circ$ is a Lie bracket and the left multiplication operator scaled by $q$ gives a representation of the associated commutator Lie algebra.
